Hong · Listen & Shadow 08

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
STORY 1 · THE BUSY DAY
👤 Interviewer
What was the busiest day you ever had?
busiest — the most busy
💬 Hong
The busiest day I ever had was a national holiday at the museum.
national holiday — a day when the whole country rests
같은 패턴으로 — The busiest day I ever had was Christmas Eve at the cafe. · The hardest shift I ever had was a rainy Sunday.
💬 Hong
There were many more visitors than usual, so I helped many people at the same time.
than usual — more than a normal day · at the same time — together, at once
같은 패턴으로 — There were more orders than usual, so we opened another counter.
💬 Hong
I stayed calm and focused on each guest's needs.
stay calm — keep your mind quiet · needs — what a person wants
같은 패턴으로 — I stayed calm and took one table at a time. · She stayed calm and kept smiling.
💬 Hong
I worked closely with my team to make sure everything went smoothly.
closely — as one team · smoothly — without problems
같은 패턴으로 — I worked closely with the kitchen to keep orders moving.
STORY 2 · THE DIFFICULT CUSTOMER
👤 Interviewer
Tell me about a difficult customer you handled.
handle — deal with, take care of
💬 Hong
Once, a child could not use an attraction because of a height restriction.
attraction — a ride or activity for visitors · restriction — a rule that limits something
같은 패턴으로 — Once, a guest could not enter because of the dress code.
💬 Hong
I explained that the rule was there for safety.
safety — being safe
같은 패턴으로 — I explained that the line was there for a reason.
💬 Hong
But first, I listened carefully to understand the parent's frustration.
frustration — the upset feeling when things go wrong
같은 패턴으로 — But first, I listened to understand what she really wanted.
💬 Hong
The real concern was the sudden change to their family's plans.
concern — worry · sudden — happening fast, without warning
같은 패턴으로 — The real concern was the waiting time, not the price.
💬 Hong
So I found other attractions the whole family could enjoy.
the whole family — everyone in the family
같은 패턴으로 — So I found a seat where the whole group could sit together.
STORY 3 · THE VISITOR I REMEMBER
👤 Interviewer
Who do you still remember among all those visitors?
among — in a group of
💬 Hong
The guest I remember most was a foreign visitor.
foreign — from another country
같은 패턴으로 — The guest I remember most was an old man with a camera.
💬 Hong
We could only accept card payments, but he only had cash.
accept — take, receive · cash — paper money
같은 패턴으로 — We could only take reservations, but he walked in.
💬 Hong
So I paid with my own card and took the cash from him.
own — belonging to me
같은 패턴으로 — So I paid with my own money and fixed it later.
💬 Hong
After work, I bought a lottery ticket with that cash — and won a small prize.
lottery — a game of luck with numbers · prize — something you win
같은 패턴으로 — After work, I bought a coffee with the tip — best coffee ever.
💬 Hong
Kindness can come back to you in a good way.
kindness — being kind
같은 패턴으로 — Hard work comes back to you in a good way.
STORY 4 · THE CLOSE CALL
👤 Interviewer
Was there a moment when something felt dangerous at work?
dangerous — not safe
💬 Hong
One day, a young child hit a streetlight and was seriously hurt.
seriously — badly · hurt — injured
같은 패턴으로 — One day, a guest slipped on the wet floor and was hurt.
💬 Hong
I was surprised, but I told my manager right away.
right away — immediately, at once
같은 패턴으로 — I was scared, but I called for help right away.
💬 Hong
We called an ambulance, and while we waited, I gave the child first aid.
first aid — simple medical help you give first
같은 패턴으로 — While we waited, I kept everyone away from the glass.
💬 Hong
I helped the child stay calm until help arrived.
arrive — come, get there
같은 패턴으로 — I helped the guest stay warm until the taxi came.
💬 Hong
Afterward, I suggested putting up safety signs and removing dangerous things.
suggest — say an idea · put up — install, place
같은 패턴으로 — Afterward, I suggested moving the shelf away from the door.
